review_candidates.title: Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. review_candidates.title: EHR Implementation Project Manager – EMR / Practice Management
review_candidates.description: 📍 Ahmedabad, Gujarat | UK business hours | Notice periods up to 60 days Take UK clinics from their first workflow workshop to a live service you continue to own Have you implemented eClinicalWorks (eCW) , configured an ambulatory EMR or Practice Management system, or helped a clinic or hospital get more out of its live EHR or HMIS ? Script Assist is hiring an EHR Implementation Project Manager to lead UK clinics and pharmacies through discovery, configuration, product demos, training and go-live. Once the customer is live, you’ll stay their main contact: helping them solve problems, improve workflows and get more from the platform. If you’ve worked as an Implementation Project Manager, EMR Project Manager, Post Implementation Project Manager , or as a Strategic Account Manager with hands-on EHR implementation experience , we’d like to hear from you. We also welcome Clinical Application Specialists and Software Training Specialists who have helped design or configure client workflows and are ready to lead the wider rollout. 🏥 About Script Assist Script Assist builds the technology and operating infrastructure behind private healthcare in the UK. Our platform supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month , with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist medicine. Our software connects patient registration, appointments, consultations and prescribing with pharmacy dispensing, inventory, payments and the patient app. A change you make to a clinic’s workflow can affect what the clinician sees, what the pharmacy receives and what the patient does next. You’ll work directly with those customers and with the Product and Engineering teams building the platform. ⚙️ What you’ll own Discovery and workflow design. Lead workshops with clinicians, practice managers and pharmacy teams. Understand how they work today, recommend a better setup and turn agreed requirements into configuration decisions. EMR and Practice Management configuration. Set up workflows, clinical templates, forms, user roles, permissions and system rules. Work across patient onboarding, scheduling, provider documentation, prescribing, repeat prescriptions and pharmacy handoffs. Product demos, training and go-live. Show customers how their workflow will run in the system. Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), train providers and practice staff, coordinate migration and integration dependencies, and support customers through launch and hypercare. Post-implementation optimisation. Stay close to the customer after launch. Diagnose live issues, improve workflows and adoption, and explain what can be solved through configuration or training. Where a change needs Product or Engineering, define the problem clearly, validate the fix and follow it through with the customer. 🔎 The experience we’re looking for Typically 3–8 years implementing, configuring or optimising Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Health Record (EHR), Practice Management or Hospital Management Information System (HIS / HMIS) software. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome. Hands-on experience configuring clinical or practice workflows, or designing the configuration in enough detail to explain how it works and why. Direct responsibility for delivering workflows to external healthcare customers, with experience leading workshops, demos or training for providers and practice teams. The confidence to lead UK customer conversations independently, make clear recommendations and handle escalations. Excellent spoken and written English is essential. Relevant platforms and teams We’re particularly interested in current and former eClinicalWorks colleagues with experience in US ambulatory EHR and Practice Management , India HMIS , or post-implementation optimisation . If you moved from eCW implementation or training into Strategic Account Management, International Client Management or post-go-live delivery , we’d especially like to hear from you. We also welcome equivalent experience with Altera Digital Health / Allscripts (Sunrise or TouchWorks), Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium, NextGen Enterprise, athenaOne, PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum or another substantial clinical software platform. Location, hours and applying You’ll need to be based within commuting distance of Ahmedabad and able to work Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time , including a one-hour break. That’s 13:30–22:30 IST during British Summer Time and 14:30–23:30 IST during UK winter time. Candidates who can join within 60 calendar days are welcome.
